interpretations.note: As directed by the owner on 3 Oct 2026 (worklog/2026-10-03_session-08_prompt.md §3): the EPC Contractor's ISO 9001:2015 certificate must be valid (current) at the latest amended Proposal Due Date, 26 November 2026, 14:00 Riyadh time (VOL-I 2.6 defines the Proposal Due Date as the date and time in 6.1 as amended; ADD-01 2.1 moved the date and kept the time; ADD-02 does not change it). It must also be issued by an accredited certification body, and a copy must be submitted with Envelope A (VOL-I 8.3). VOL-I 8.3 states no consequence of its own; the requirement is checked at the responsiveness and mandatory compliance stage on a pass or fail basis, and only Proposals that pass that stage go on to technical evaluation (VOL-I 11.1(i)-(ii)). The pack gives no ISO-specific rejection label and says nothing on whether a failure can be cured; neither is implied. [Applied from proposal P-S08-VOL-I-8.3-01 by Claude Code (assistant), on Ahmad's written instruction of 3 Oct 2026 (session 08 §3) on 2026-10-03.]
